description: This file is a shell script for testing 'git fetch' behavior with submodules, including recursive fetches, configuration overrides, and handling of edge cases in submodule updates.

methods.name: write_expected_sub
methods.description: Writes expected output for submodule fetch status to a file based on commit hashes.

methods.name: write_expected_sub2
methods.description: Writes expected output for a second submodule's fetch status.

methods.name: write_expected_deep
methods.description: Writes expected output for nested deep submodule fetch status.

methods.name: write_expected_super
methods.description: Writes expected output for superproject fetch status.

methods.name: add_submodule_commits
methods.description: Creates new commits in submodules and generates expected fetch output files.

methods.name: add_superproject_commits
methods.description: Creates new commits in the superproject including submodule updates and writes expected fetch output.

methods.name: verify_fetch_result
methods.description: Verifies the actual fetch output against expected output files.

methods.name: add_commit_push
methods.description: Adds files, commits, and pushes in a given repository.

methods.name: compare_refs_in_dir
methods.description: Compares refs between two repositories to verify identical state.

methods.name: fetch_with_recursion_abort
methods.description: Performs a fetch with a sed command to prevent infinite recursion in submodule fetch.
